/// Validate and tokenize borrowed source before touching the destination, then
/// atomically replace an existing regular file or publish a missing file.
/// `token_capacity` bounds the owned token vector and source/path remain borrowed.
pub fn source_save_noop<'source>(
    source: &'source [u8],
    path: &[u8],
    token_capacity: usize,
    mut hooks: Option<&mut dyn SourceSaveHooks>,
) -> SourceSaveResult<'source> {
    if path.is_empty() {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::Invalid, XmlDiagnostic::default());
    }
    if path.len() > MAX_ATOMIC_FILE_PATH_BYTES {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::PathLimit, XmlDiagnostic::default());
    }
    if source.len() > MAX_INPUT_BYTES {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(
            SourceSaveError::InputLimit,
            XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: MAX_INPUT_BYTES },
        );
    }

    let (tokens, parsed) = tokenize_with_capacity(source, XmlLimits::default(), token_capacity);
    if parsed.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::Tokenizer, parsed.diagnostic);
    }

    let replaced = match hooks.as_deref_mut() {
        Some(hook) => atomic_file_replace(path, source, Some(&mut ReplaceAdapter(hook))),
        None => atomic_file_replace(path, source, None),
    };
    let file_result = if replaced.error == AtomicFileReplaceError::NotFound {
        let created = match hooks.as_deref_mut() {
            Some(hook) => atomic_file_create_new(path, source, Some(&mut CreateAdapter(hook))),
            None => atomic_file_create_new(path, source, None),
        };
        map_create_result(created)
    } else {
        replaced
    };
    let error = match file_result.error {
        AtomicFileReplaceError::Ok => SourceSaveError::Ok,
        AtomicFileReplaceError::Durability => SourceSaveError::Durability,
        _ => SourceSaveError::Destination,
    };
    SourceSaveResult {
        error,
        parse_diagnostic: parsed.diagnostic,
        tokens,
        file_result,
        _source: PhantomData,
    }
}

fn map_create_result(created: AtomicFileCreateNewResult) -> AtomicFileReplaceResult {
    AtomicFileReplaceResult {
        error: match created.error {
            AtomicFileCreateNewError::Ok => AtomicFileReplaceError::Ok,
            AtomicFileCreateNewError::Durability => AtomicFileReplaceError::Durability,
            _ => AtomicFileReplaceError::Io,
        },
        file_synced: created.file_synced,
        renamed: created.published,
        directory_synced: created.directory_synced,
    }
}

#[test]
fn validation_precedence_and_tokenizer_diagnostics_prevent_destination_calls() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let valid = b"<svg/>";
    let empty_path: &[u8] = b"";
    let mut gates = Gates::default();
    let result = source_save_noop(valid, empty_path, 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Invalid);
    assert_eq!(source_save_error_name(result.error), "invalid");
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let long_path = vec![b'x'; MAX_ATOMIC_FILE_PATH_BYTES + 1];
    let oversized = vec![b'x'; MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1];
    let result = source_save_noop(&oversized, &long_path, 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::PathLimit, "path limit precedes source limit");
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);
    let result = source_save_noop(&oversized, b"target", 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, MAX_INPUT_BYTES);
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let malformed = b"<svg><broken></svg>";
    let missing = fixture.path("must-not-exist.svg");
    let result = source_save_noop(malformed, &missing, 128, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Tokenizer);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::MismatchedTag);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, 13);
    assert!(result.tokens.is_empty());
    assert!(!target(&missing).exists());
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let result = source_save_noop(valid, &missing, 0, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Tokenizer);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, 0);
    assert!(!target(&missing).exists());
}

typedef enum source_save_error {
    SOURCE_SAVE_OK = 0,
    SOURCE_SAVE_INVALID,
    SOURCE_SAVE_INPUT_LIMIT,
    SOURCE_SAVE_PATH_LIMIT,
    SOURCE_SAVE_TOKENIZER,
    SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION,
    SOURCE_SAVE_DURABILITY
} source_save_error;

typedef struct source_save_result {
    source_save_error error;
    svg_xml_diagnostic parse_diagnostic;
    platform_atomic_file_result file_result;
} source_save_result;

/* Source, path and tokenizer storage are borrowed and remain caller-owned.
 * Tokenization must succeed before the destination adapter is called. */
source_save_result source_save_noop(base_bytes source, base_bytes path,
                                    svg_xml_token *tokens, size_t token_capacity,
                                    const platform_atomic_file_hooks *hooks);
const char *source_save_error_name(source_save_error error);

source_save_result source_save_noop(base_bytes source, base_bytes path,
                                    svg_xml_token *tokens, size_t token_capacity,
                                    const platform_atomic_file_hooks *hooks)
{
    source_save_result result;
    memset(&result, 0, sizeof(result));
    result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_INVALID;
    if (!base_bytes_valid(source) || !base_bytes_valid(path) || path.len == 0 ||
        (token_capacity > 0 && tokens == NULL)) return result;
    if (path.len > PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_MAX_PATH_BYTES) {
        result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_PATH_LIMIT;
        return result;
    }

    svg_xml_options options = svg_xml_default_options();
    if (source.len > options.limits.input_bytes) {
        result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_INPUT_LIMIT;
        return result;
    }
    svg_xml_result parsed = svg_xml_tokenize(source, options, tokens, token_capacity);
    result.parse_diagnostic = parsed.diagnostic;
    if (parsed.diagnostic.category != SVG_XML_ERROR_NONE) {
        result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_TOKENIZER;
        return result;
    }

    result.file_result = platform_atomic_file_replace(path, source, hooks);
    if (result.file_result.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
        platform_atomic_new_file_hooks create_hooks = {0};
        if (hooks != NULL) {
            create_hooks.write = hooks->write;
            create_hooks.context = hooks->context;
        }
        platform_atomic_new_file_result created = platform_atomic_file_create_new(
            path, source, &create_hooks);
        result.file_result.error =
            created.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_NEW_FILE_OK ? PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_OK :
            created.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_NEW_FILE_DURABILITY ?
                PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_DURABILITY : PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_IO;
        result.file_result.file_fsynced = created.file_fsynced;
        result.file_result.renamed = created.published;
        result.file_result.directory_fsynced = created.directory_fsynced;
    }
    if (result.file_result.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_OK) result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_OK;
    else if (result.file_result.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_DURABILITY)
        result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_DURABILITY;
    else result.error = SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION;
    return result;
}

const char *source_save_error_name(source_save_error error)
{
    switch (error) {
        case SOURCE_SAVE_OK: return "ok";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_INVALID: return "invalid";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_INPUT_LIMIT: return "input_limit";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_PATH_LIMIT: return "path_limit";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_TOKENIZER: return "tokenizer";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION: return "destination";
        case SOURCE_SAVE_DURABILITY: return "durability";
        default: return "unknown";
    }
}

static const uint8_t fixture[] =
    "<?xml version='1.0' encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\r\n"
    "<!-- authored preservation fixture -->\n"
    "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:x='urn:x' data-q=\"a'b\">\r"
    "  <metadata>  keep  whitespace\r\ninside </metadata>\n"
    "  <x:unknown x:quoted='single' note=\"double\"/>\r\n"
    "</svg>\n";

struct injected {
    bool fail_write;
    bool fail_rename;
    bool short_write;
    unsigned calls;
    const char *observe_absent_path;
    bool observed_absent;
};

static ssize_t test_write(int fd, const void *bytes, size_t length, void *context)
{
    struct injected *state = context;
    state->calls++;
    if (state->observe_absent_path != NULL) {
        if (access(state->observe_absent_path, F_OK) == 0) {
            errno = EEXIST;
            return -1;
        }
        state->observed_absent = true;
    }
    if (state->fail_write) {
        state->fail_write = false;
        errno = EIO;
        return -1;
    }
    if (state->short_write && length > 3) length = 3;
    return write(fd, bytes, length);
}

static int test_rename(const char *from, const char *to, void *context)
{
    struct injected *state = context;
    if (state->fail_rename) {
        state->fail_rename = false;
        errno = EIO;
        return -1;
    }
    return rename(from, to);
}

static bool write_file(const char *path, const uint8_t *bytes, size_t length, mode_t mode)
{
    int fd = open(path, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, mode);
    if (fd < 0) return false;
    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < length) {
        ssize_t count = write(fd, bytes + offset, length - offset);
        if (count <= 0) { (void)close(fd); return false; }
        offset += (size_t)count;
    }
    return fchmod(fd, mode) == 0 && close(fd) == 0;
}

static bool target_is(const char *path, const uint8_t *expected, size_t length, mode_t mode)
{
    struct stat info;
    if (stat(path, &info) != 0 || (info.st_mode & 07777) != mode ||
        (size_t)info.st_size != length) return false;
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) return false;
    uint8_t buffer[4096];
    if (length > sizeof(buffer)) { (void)close(fd); return false; }
    ssize_t count = read(fd, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
    bool same = count >= 0 && (size_t)count == length && memcmp(buffer, expected, length) == 0;
    return close(fd) == 0 && same;
}

static size_t temp_count(const char *directory)
{
    DIR *dir = opendir(directory);
    if (dir == NULL) return SIZE_MAX;
    size_t count = 0;
    struct dirent *entry;
    while ((entry = readdir(dir)) != NULL)
        if (strncmp(entry->d_name, ".vexel-save-", 12) == 0 ||
            strncmp(entry->d_name, ".vexel-new-", 11) == 0) count++;
    (void)closedir(dir);
    return count;
}

static bool test_save_and_failures(const char *directory)
{
    char target[1024];
    int written = snprintf(target, sizeof(target), "%s/document.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(target));
    static const uint8_t old_bytes[] = "<svg>original</svg>";
    const mode_t mode = 0640;
    CHECK(write_file(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    svg_xml_token tokens[128];
    base_bytes source = {fixture, sizeof(fixture) - 1};
    base_bytes path = {(const uint8_t *)target, strlen(target)};
    struct injected state = {.short_write = true};
    platform_atomic_file_hooks hooks = {test_write, test_rename, &state};

    source_save_result saved = source_save_noop(source, path, tokens, 128, &hooks);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_OK);
    CHECK(saved.file_result.file_fsynced && saved.file_result.renamed &&
          saved.file_result.directory_fsynced);
    (void)puts("native_save file_fsync=true rename=true parent_directory_fsync=true");
    CHECK(state.calls > 1);
    CHECK(target_is(target, fixture, sizeof(fixture) - 1, mode));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0);

    CHECK(write_file(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    static const uint8_t malformed[] = "<svg><broken></svg>";
    base_bytes bad = {malformed, sizeof(malformed) - 1};
    saved = source_save_noop(bad, path, tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_TOKENIZER);
    CHECK(target_is(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0);

    state = (struct injected){.fail_write = true};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, path, tokens, 128, &hooks);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION);
    CHECK(target_is(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0);

    state = (struct injected){.fail_rename = true};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, path, tokens, 128, &hooks);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION);
    CHECK(target_is(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0);

    base_bytes empty_path = {NULL, 0};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, empty_path, tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_INVALID);
    uint8_t too_long[4096];
    memset(too_long, 'x', sizeof(too_long));
    base_bytes long_path = {too_long, sizeof(too_long)};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, long_path, tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_PATH_LIMIT);
    char missing_target[1024];
    written = snprintf(missing_target, sizeof(missing_target), "%s/missing.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(missing_target));
    base_bytes missing_path = {(const uint8_t *)missing_target, strlen(missing_target)};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, missing_path, tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_OK && saved.file_result.renamed &&
          saved.file_result.file_fsynced && saved.file_result.directory_fsynced);
    CHECK(target_is(missing_target, fixture, sizeof(fixture) - 1U, 0600));
    platform_atomic_new_file_result duplicate = platform_atomic_file_create_new(
        missing_path, (base_bytes){old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1U}, NULL);
    CHECK(duplicate.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_NEW_FILE_EXISTS && !duplicate.published);
    CHECK(target_is(missing_target, fixture, sizeof(fixture) - 1U, 0600));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0U);

    char atomic_target[1024];
    written = snprintf(atomic_target, sizeof(atomic_target), "%s/atomic.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(atomic_target));
    struct injected atomic_state = {
        .short_write = true, .observe_absent_path = atomic_target};
    platform_atomic_new_file_hooks atomic_hooks = {
        .write = test_write, .context = &atomic_state};
    base_bytes atomic_path = {(const uint8_t *)atomic_target, strlen(atomic_target)};
    platform_atomic_new_file_result atomic = platform_atomic_file_create_new(
        atomic_path, source, &atomic_hooks);
    CHECK(atomic.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_NEW_FILE_OK && atomic.published &&
        atomic.directory_fsynced && atomic_state.calls > 1U &&
        atomic_state.observed_absent);
    CHECK(target_is(atomic_target, fixture, sizeof(fixture) - 1U, 0600));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0U);
    CHECK(unlink(atomic_target) == 0);

    char atomic_failed_target[1024];
    written = snprintf(atomic_failed_target, sizeof(atomic_failed_target),
        "%s/atomic-failed.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(atomic_failed_target));
    atomic_state = (struct injected){.fail_write = true,
        .observe_absent_path = atomic_failed_target};
    atomic = platform_atomic_file_create_new(
        (base_bytes){(const uint8_t *)atomic_failed_target,
            strlen(atomic_failed_target)}, source, &atomic_hooks);
    CHECK(atomic.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_NEW_FILE_IO && !atomic.published &&
        atomic_state.observed_absent && access(atomic_failed_target, F_OK) != 0);
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0U);

    char malformed_target[1024];
    written = snprintf(malformed_target, sizeof(malformed_target),
        "%s/malformed.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(malformed_target));
    saved = source_save_noop(bad,
        (base_bytes){(const uint8_t *)malformed_target, strlen(malformed_target)},
        tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_TOKENIZER &&
        access(malformed_target, F_OK) != 0 && temp_count(directory) == 0U);

    char failed_target[1024];
    written = snprintf(failed_target, sizeof(failed_target), "%s/failed.svg", directory);
    CHECK(written > 0 && (size_t)written < sizeof(failed_target));
    state = (struct injected){.fail_write = true};
    saved = source_save_noop(source,
        (base_bytes){(const uint8_t *)failed_target, strlen(failed_target)},
        tokens, 128, &hooks);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION && access(failed_target, F_OK) != 0);
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0U);
    base_bytes directory_path = {(const uint8_t *)directory, strlen(directory)};
    saved = source_save_noop(source, directory_path, tokens, 128, NULL);
    CHECK(saved.error == SOURCE_SAVE_DESTINATION);
    CHECK(saved.file_result.error == PLATFORM_ATOMIC_FILE_NOT_REGULAR);
    CHECK(target_is(target, old_bytes, sizeof(old_bytes) - 1, mode));
    CHECK(temp_count(directory) == 0);
    return true;
}

static int save_paths(const char *source_path, const char *target_path)
{
    int fd = open(source_path, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) return 2;
    struct stat info;
    if (fstat(fd, &info) != 0 || !S_ISREG(info.st_mode) || info.st_size < 0 ||
        (uintmax_t)info.st_size > (uintmax_t)(16u * 1024u * 1024u)) {
        (void)close(fd);
        return 2;
    }
    size_t length = (size_t)info.st_size;
    uint8_t *source = length == 0 ? NULL : malloc(length);
    svg_xml_token *tokens = calloc(65536, sizeof(*tokens));
    if ((length != 0 && source == NULL) || tokens == NULL) {
        free(source);
        free(tokens);
        (void)close(fd);
        return 2;
    }
    size_t offset = 0;
    while (offset < length) {
        ssize_t count = read(fd, source + offset, length - offset);
        if (count <= 0) { free(source); free(tokens); (void)close(fd); return 2; }
        offset += (size_t)count;
    }
    if (close(fd) != 0) { free(source); free(tokens); return 2; }
    base_bytes source_bytes = {source, length};
    base_bytes path = {(const uint8_t *)target_path, strlen(target_path)};
    source_save_result result = source_save_noop(source_bytes, path, tokens, 65536, NULL);
    if (result.error != SOURCE_SAVE_OK) {
        (void)fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", source_save_error_name(result.error));
        free(source);
        free(tokens);
        return 1;
    }
    free(source);
    free(tokens);
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc == 4 && strcmp(argv[1], "--save") == 0)
        return save_paths(argv[2], argv[3]);
    if (argc != 1) return 2;
    char cwd[1024], template[1024];
    if (getcwd(cwd, sizeof(cwd)) == NULL ||
        (mkdir(".cache", 0700) != 0 && errno != EEXIST)) return 1;
    int length = snprintf(template, sizeof(template),
        "%s/.cache/vexel-source-save-XXXXXX", cwd);
    if (length <= 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(template)) return 1;
    char *directory = mkdtemp(template);
    if (directory == NULL) return 1;
    bool passed = test_save_and_failures(directory);
    char target[1024];
    (void)snprintf(target, sizeof(target), "%s/document.svg", directory);
    char missing_target[1024];
    (void)snprintf(missing_target, sizeof(missing_target), "%s/missing.svg", directory);
    char failed_target[1024];
    (void)snprintf(failed_target, sizeof(failed_target), "%s/failed.svg", directory);
    char malformed_target[1024];
    (void)snprintf(malformed_target, sizeof(malformed_target), "%s/malformed.svg", directory);
    (void)unlink(target);
    (void)unlink(missing_target);
    (void)unlink(failed_target);
    (void)unlink(malformed_target);
    (void)rmdir(directory);
    if (!passed) return 1;
    (void)puts("source-save C tests passed; byte equality, permission preservation, atomic create, no-replace collision, and cleanup verified");
    return 0;
}

//! Bounded XML 1.0 byte-preserving tokenizer and resumable tag reader.

use vexel_base::Span;

pub const MAX_READER_SOURCE_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_READER_STEP_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub const MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES: usize = 4096;

mod tokenizer;
pub use tokenizer::*;
mod stream;
pub use stream::XmlTokenStream;
mod utf8_scan;

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `Char` production.
pub const fn is_xml_char(cp: u32) -> bool {
    cp == 0x9
        || cp == 0xa
        || cp == 0xd
        || (cp >= 0x20 && cp <= 0xd7ff)
        || (cp >= 0xe000 && cp <= 0xfffd)
        || (cp >= 0x10000 && cp <= 0x10ffff)
}

/// Decodes one strict UTF-8 scalar at `position` and returns it with the next
/// byte offset. On failure, callers retain their original position.
pub fn utf8_next(bytes: &[u8], position: usize) -> Option<(u32, usize)> {
    let first = *bytes.get(position)?;
    let (count, mut value) = match first {
        0x00..=0x7f => (1usize, u32::from(first)),
        0xc2..=0xdf => (2, u32::from(first & 0x1f)),
        0xe0..=0xef => (3, u32::from(first & 0x0f)),
        0xf0..=0xf4 => (4, u32::from(first & 0x07)),
        _ => return None,
    };
    let end = position.checked_add(count)?;
    let tail = bytes.get(position + 1..end)?;
    for &byte in tail {
        if byte & 0xc0 != 0x80 {
            return None;
        }
        value = (value << 6) | u32::from(byte & 0x3f);
    }
    let second = *tail.first().unwrap_or(&0);
    if (count == 3 && ((first == 0xe0 && second < 0xa0) || (first == 0xed && second >= 0xa0)))
        || (count == 4 && ((first == 0xf0 && second < 0x90) || (first == 0xf4 && second >= 0x90)))
        || value > 0x10ffff
        || (0xd800..=0xdfff).contains(&value)
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some((value, end))
}

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `NameStartChar` production.
pub const fn is_name_start(cp: u32) -> bool {
    cp == 0x3a
        || cp == 0x5f
        || (cp >= 0x41 && cp <= 0x5a)
        || (cp >= 0x61 && cp <= 0x7a)
        || (cp >= 0xc0 && cp <= 0xd6)
        || (cp >= 0xd8 && cp <= 0xf6)
        || (cp >= 0xf8 && cp <= 0x2ff)
        || (cp >= 0x370 && cp <= 0x37d)
        || (cp >= 0x37f && cp <= 0x1fff)
        || (cp >= 0x200c && cp <= 0x200d)
        || (cp >= 0x2070 && cp <= 0x218f)
        || (cp >= 0x2c00 && cp <= 0x2fef)
        || (cp >= 0x3001 && cp <= 0xd7ff)
        || (cp >= 0xf900 && cp <= 0xfdcf)
        || (cp >= 0xfdf0 && cp <= 0xfffd)
        || (cp >= 0x10000 && cp <= 0xeffff)
}

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `NameChar` production.
pub const fn is_name_char(cp: u32) -> bool {
    is_name_start(cp)
        || cp == 0x2d
        || cp == 0x2e
        || (cp >= 0x30 && cp <= 0x39)
        || cp == 0xb7
        || (cp >= 0x300 && cp <= 0x36f)
        || (cp >= 0x203f && cp <= 0x2040)
}

/// XML whitespace is exactly space, tab, line feed, and carriage return.
pub const fn is_xml_whitespace(byte: u8) -> bool {
    matches!(byte, 0x20 | 0x09 | 0x0a | 0x0d)
}

enum Probe { None, Comment, Cdata, Doctype }
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DoctypePhase { Start, Main, Quote, Subset, SubsetQuote, Lt, Bang, BangDash, Comment, Pi }
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DoctypeResult { More, Done, Bad }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct DoctypeState {
    phase: DoctypePhase,
    quote: u8,
    run: u8,
    subset_closed: bool,
}

impl Default for DoctypeState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { phase: DoctypePhase::Start, quote: 0, run: 0, subset_closed: false }
    }
}

impl DoctypeState {
    fn step(&mut self, byte: u8) -> DoctypeResult {
        loop {
            match self.phase {
                DoctypePhase::Start => {
                    if !is_xml_whitespace(byte) { return DoctypeResult::Bad; }
                    self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main;
                    return DoctypeResult::More;
                }
                DoctypePhase::Main => match byte {
                    b'"' | b'\'' => { self.quote = byte; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Quote; }
                    b'[' => {
                        if self.subset_closed { return DoctypeResult::Bad; }
                        self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset;
                    }
                    b'>' => return DoctypeResult::Done,
                    b'<' => return DoctypeResult::Bad,
                    _ => {}
                },
                DoctypePhase::Quote => if byte == self.quote { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main; },
                DoctypePhase::Subset => match byte {
                    b'"' | b'\'' => { self.quote = byte; self.phase = DoctypePhase::SubsetQuote; }
                    b'<' => self.phase = DoctypePhase::Lt,
                    b']' => { self.subset_closed = true; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main; }
                    _ => {}
                },
                DoctypePhase::SubsetQuote => if byte == self.quote { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; },
                DoctypePhase::Lt => match byte {
                    b'!' => { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Bang; return DoctypeResult::More; }
                    b'?' => { self.run = 0; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Pi; return DoctypeResult::More; }
                    _ => { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; }
                },
                DoctypePhase::Bang => if byte == b'-' { self.phase = DoctypePhase::BangDash; return DoctypeResult::More; } else { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; },
                DoctypePhase::BangDash => if byte == b'-' { self.run = 0; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Comment; return DoctypeResult::More; } else { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; },
                DoctypePhase::Comment => {
                    if byte == b'-' { self.run = self.run.saturating_add(1).min(2); }
                    else if byte == b'>' && self.run >= 2 { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; }
                    else { self.run = 0; }
                }
                DoctypePhase::Pi => {
                    if byte == b'>' && self.run == 1 { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; }
                    else { self.run = u8::from(byte == b'?'); }
                }
            }
            return DoctypeResult::More;
        }
    }
}

/// Borrowing scanner. Source bytes remain immutable and are never normalized.
pub struct XmlReader<'a> {
    source: &'a [u8],
    bytes_read: usize,
    token_start: usize,
    name_offset: usize,
    name_length: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
    probe_position: usize,
    mode: Mode,
    probe: Probe,
    closing: bool,
    name_complete: bool,
    in_quote: bool,
    pending_slash: bool,
    self_closing: bool,
    quote: u8,
    complete: bool,
    element_seen: bool,
    doctype_seen: bool,
    doctype: DoctypeState,
    diagnostic: Diagnostic,
}

impl<'a> XmlReader<'a> {
    /// Starts a reader borrowing `source` until this reader is dropped.
    pub fn new(source: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self, ReaderStatus> {
        if source.len() > MAX_READER_SOURCE_BYTES { return Err(ReaderStatus::Limit); }
        Ok(Self {
            source, bytes_read: 0, token_start: 0, name_offset: 0, name_length: 0,
            attribute_count: 0, probe_position: 0, mode: Mode::Text, probe: Probe::None,
            closing: false, name_complete: false, in_quote: false, pending_slash: false,
            self_closing: false, quote: 0, complete: false, element_seen: false,
            doctype_seen: false, doctype: DoctypeState::default(), diagnostic: Diagnostic::clear(),
        })
    }

    /// Advances by at most `byte_budget` bytes, capped at 64 KiB, and emits
    /// complete lexical tags. Returning false from the callback is an error.
    pub fn step<F>(&mut self, byte_budget: usize, mut on_tag: F) -> ReaderStatus
    where F: FnMut(ReaderTag) -> bool {
        if byte_budget == 0 { return ReaderStatus::Invalid; }
        if self.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None { return ReaderStatus::Malformed; }
        if self.complete { return ReaderStatus::Complete; }
        let budget = byte_budget.min(MAX_READER_STEP_BYTES);
        let end = self.bytes_read.saturating_add(budget).min(self.source.len());
        while self.bytes_read < end && self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            let at = self.bytes_read;
            let byte = self.source[at];
            match self.mode {
                Mode::Text => if byte == b'<' {
                    self.mode = Mode::Probe;
                    self.token_start = at;
                    self.probe = Probe::None;
                    self.probe_position = 0;
                },
                Mode::Probe => self.scan_probe(byte, at),
                Mode::Tag => {
                    if !self.name_complete {
                        if is_reader_name_byte(byte) {
                            if self.name_length == MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset); }
                            else { self.name_length += 1; }
                            self.bytes_read += 1;
                            continue;
                        }
                        if self.name_length == 0 { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset); }
                        else { self.name_complete = true; }
                    }
                    if self.in_quote {
                        if byte == self.quote { self.in_quote = false; }
                    } else if byte == b'\'' || byte == b'"' {
                        self.in_quote = true;
                        self.quote = byte;
                        self.attribute_count = self.attribute_count.saturating_add(1);
                    } else if byte == b'/' { self.pending_slash = true; }
                    else if byte == b'>' {
                        self.self_closing = self.pending_slash;
                        if !self.emit_tag(at + 1, &mut on_tag) { break; }
                    } else { self.pending_slash = false; }
                }
                Mode::Comment if byte == b'>' && at >= 2 && &self.source[at - 2..at] == b"--" => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                Mode::Cdata if byte == b'>' && at >= 2 && &self.source[at - 2..at] == b"]]" => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                Mode::Doctype => match self.doctype.step(byte) {
                    DoctypeResult::Bad => self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, at),
                    DoctypeResult::Done => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                    DoctypeResult::More => {}
                },
                Mode::Pi if byte == b'>' && at > 0 && self.source[at - 1] == b'?' => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                _ => {}
            }
            self.bytes_read += 1;
        }
        if self.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None { return ReaderStatus::Malformed; }
        if self.bytes_read == self.source.len() {
            if self.mode != Mode::Text { self.fail(XmlError::IncompleteDocument, self.source.len()); }
            else { self.complete = true; }
        }
        if self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            if self.complete { ReaderStatus::Complete } else { ReaderStatus::Ok }
        } else { ReaderStatus::Malformed }
    }

    pub fn progress(&self) -> ReaderProgress {
        ReaderProgress { bytes_read: self.bytes_read, source_bytes: self.source.len(), diagnostic: self.diagnostic, complete: self.complete }
    }

    fn scan_probe(&mut self, byte: u8, at: usize) {
        if self.probe_position == 0 {
            if byte == b'?' { self.mode = Mode::Pi; }
            else if byte == b'/' {
                self.begin_tag(true, at + 1);
            } else if byte == b'!' { self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if is_reader_name_byte(byte) {
                self.begin_tag(false, at);
                self.name_length = 1;
            } else { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, at); }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::None {
            if byte == b'-' { self.probe = Probe::Comment; self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if byte == b'[' { self.probe = Probe::Cdata; self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if byte == b'D' && !self.doctype_seen && !self.element_seen {
                self.probe = Probe::Doctype;
                self.probe_position = 1;
            } else { self.fail(XmlError::UnsupportedDtd, self.token_start); }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::Comment {
            if byte != b'-' { self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, self.token_start); }
            else { self.mode = Mode::Comment; }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::Doctype {
            const TAIL: &[u8] = b"OCTYPE";
            let index = self.probe_position - 1;
            if TAIL.get(index).copied() != Some(byte) { self.fail(XmlError::UnsupportedDtd, self.token_start); }
            else if self.probe_position == TAIL.len() {
                self.mode = Mode::Doctype;
                self.doctype_seen = true;
                self.doctype = DoctypeState::default();
            } else { self.probe_position += 1; }
        } else {
            const TAIL: &[u8] = b"CDATA[";
            let index = self.probe_position - 1;
            if index >= TAIL.len() || TAIL[index] != byte { self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, self.token_start); }
            else if self.probe_position == TAIL.len() { self.mode = Mode::Cdata; }
            else { self.probe_position += 1; }
        }
    }

    fn begin_tag(&mut self, closing: bool, name_offset: usize) {
        self.mode = Mode::Tag;
        self.closing = closing;
        self.name_offset = name_offset;
        self.name_length = 0;
        self.attribute_count = 0;
        self.name_complete = false;
        self.pending_slash = false;
    }

    fn emit_tag<F>(&mut self, end: usize, callback: &mut F) -> bool
    where F: FnMut(ReaderTag) -> bool {
        if self.name_length == 0 || self.name_length > MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES {
            self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset);
            return false;
        }
        if !self.closing { self.element_seen = true; }
        let kind = if self.closing { TagKind::EndElement } else if self.self_closing { TagKind::EmptyElement } else { TagKind::StartElement };
        let tag = ReaderTag {
            kind,
            source: Span { start: self.token_start, end },
            name: Span { start: self.name_offset, end: self.name_offset + self.name_length },
            attribute_count: self.attribute_count,
        };
        if !callback(tag) {
            self.fail(XmlError::OutputExhausted, self.token_start);
            return false;
        }
        self.mode = Mode::Text;
        true
    }

    fn fail(&mut self, category: XmlError, offset: usize) {
        if self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            self.diagnostic = Diagnostic { category, offset: offset.min(self.source.len()) };
        }
    }
}

fn is_reader_name_byte(byte: u8) -> bool {
    byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte >= 0x80 || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.' | b':')
}

/// Largest request accepted by [`fill_random`].
pub const MAX_RANDOM_BYTES: usize = 256;

/// Failure reported by a native system service.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum SystemError {
    /// The requested random buffer exceeds the wrapper's fixed bound.
    RandomRequestTooLarge { requested: usize, maximum: usize },
    /// `SecRandomCopyBytes` returned a nonzero `OSStatus`.
    RandomStatus(i32),
    /// `getpeereid` failed; this is the `errno` value captured immediately.
    PeerCredentialsErrno(i32),
}

impl fmt::Display for SystemError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::RandomRequestTooLarge { requested, maximum } => {
                write!(f, "random request of {requested} bytes exceeds {maximum}")
            }
            Self::RandomStatus(status) => {
                write!(f, "SecRandomCopyBytes failed with OSStatus {status}")
            }
            Self::PeerCredentialsErrno(errno) => {
                write!(f, "getpeereid failed with errno {errno}")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for SystemError {}

/// Fill `output` with bytes from Apple's default cryptographic random source.
///
/// Empty output succeeds without calling the native function. Requests above
/// [`MAX_RANDOM_BYTES`] are rejected before any native call. If the native
/// call fails, every byte in `output` is cleared before its status is returned.
pub fn fill_random(output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
    if output.len() > MAX_RANDOM_BYTES {
        return Err(SystemError::RandomRequestTooLarge {
            requested: output.len(),
            maximum: MAX_RANDOM_BYTES,
        });
    }
    if output.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }

    let status = sys::fill_random(output);
    random_result(status, output)
}

fn random_result(status: i32, output: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), SystemError> {
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        output.fill(0);
        Err(SystemError::RandomStatus(status))
    }
}

/// Return the real user ID of the calling process, as reported by `getuid`.
pub fn current_uid() -> u32 {
    sys::current_uid()
}

/// Return the user and group IDs associated with a connected peer socket.
///
/// The descriptor is borrowed only for the duration of this call. Credentials
/// are returned as Darwin's 32-bit `uid_t` and `gid_t` values.
pub fn peer_credentials(socket: BorrowedFd<'_>) -> Result<(u32, u32), SystemError> {
    sys::peer_credentials(socket).map_err(SystemError::PeerCredentialsErrno)
}

pub(super) fn write_all(
    file: &mut File,
    bytes: &[u8],
    mut before_write: impl FnMut(&File, &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut offset = 0;
    while offset < bytes.len() {
        let remaining = &bytes[offset..];
        match before_write(file, remaining).and_then(|amount| {
            if amount == 0 {
                return Ok(0);
            }
            if amount > remaining.len() {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "atomic file write hook exceeded its input",
                ));
            }
            use std::io::Write;
            file.write(&remaining[..amount])
        }) {
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
            Ok(0) => {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::WriteZero,
                    "atomic file write returned zero",
                ));
            }
            Ok(amount) if amount > bytes.len() - offset => {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "atomic file write exceeded its input",
                ));
            }
            Ok(amount) => offset += amount,
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Perform the directory sync natively and consume the descriptor once.
/// Darwin's legacy contract ignores close errors after the sync result.
pub(super) fn sync_directory(directory: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
    let file = File::open(directory)?;
    let sync = file.sync_all();
    let close = crate::sys::close_checked(file.into());
    match sync {
        Err(error) => Err(error),
        Ok(()) => {
            let _ = close;
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Fault(pub(crate) XmlError, pub(crate) usize);

struct Parser<'a> { src: &'a [u8], pos: usize, depth: usize, roots: usize, attrs: usize,
    limits: XmlLimits, tokens: Vec<XmlToken>, result: XmlResult, open_names: Vec<XmlSpan>, token_capacity: usize }
impl<'a> Parser<'a> {
    fn fault<T>(&self, e: XmlError, at: usize) -> Result<T, Fault> { Err(Fault(e, at.min(self.src.len()))) }
    fn emit(&mut self, token: XmlToken, at: usize) -> Result<(), Fault> {
        if self.tokens.len() >= self.token_capacity { return self.fault(XmlError::OutputExhausted, at); }
        if self.tokens.try_reserve(1).is_err() { return self.fault(XmlError::OutputExhausted, at); }
        self.tokens.push(token); self.result.token_count += 1; Ok(())
    }
    fn node(&mut self, at: usize) -> Result<(), Fault> {
        let n = self.result.node_count.checked_add(1).ok_or(Fault(XmlError::NodeLimit, at))?;
        if n > self.limits.nodes { return self.fault(XmlError::NodeLimit, at); } self.result.node_count = n; Ok(())
    }
    fn starts(&self, b: usize, lit: &[u8]) -> bool { self.src.get(b..b.saturating_add(lit.len())) == Some(lit) }
    fn ws(&self, p: &mut usize) { while self.src.get(*p).is_some_and(|b| is_xml_whitespace(*b)) { *p += 1; } }
    fn name(&self, p: &mut usize, qname: bool) -> Result<(XmlSpan, XmlSpan, XmlSpan), Fault> {
        let start = *p; let Some((cp, mut q)) = utf8_next(self.src, *p) else { return self.fault(XmlError::InvalidName, start) };
        if !is_name_start(cp) { return self.fault(XmlError::InvalidName, start); }
        let mut colon = None;
        while q < self.src.len() {
            let before = q; let Some((cp, next)) = utf8_next(self.src, q) else { return self.fault(XmlError::InvalidUtf8, q) };
            if !is_name_char(cp) { break; }
            if cp == 0x3a { if qname && colon.is_some() { return self.fault(XmlError::InvalidName, colon.unwrap_or(before)); } if colon.is_none() { colon = Some(before); } }

pub(super) fn write_all(
    file: &mut File,
    bytes: &[u8],
    mut before_write: impl FnMut(&File, &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut offset = 0;
    while offset < bytes.len() {
        let remaining = &bytes[offset..];
        match before_write(file, remaining).and_then(|amount| {
            if amount == 0 {
                return Ok(0);
            }
            if amount > remaining.len() {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "atomic file write hook exceeded its input",
                ));
            }
            use std::io::Write;
            file.write(&remaining[..amount])
        }) {
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(error) => return Err(error),
            Ok(0) => {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::WriteZero,
                    "atomic file write returned zero",
                ));
            }
            Ok(amount) if amount > bytes.len() - offset => {
                return Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
                    "atomic file write exceeded its input",
                    "atomic file write exceeded its input",
                ));
            }
            Ok(amount) => offset += amount,
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn missing_target_uses_native_no_replace_create_and_reports_durability() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let path = fixture.path("new.svg");
    let target_path = target(&path);
    let mut gates = Gates { short_writes: true, ..Gates::default() };
    let result = source_save_noop(FIXTURE, &path, 128, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Ok);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&target_path).unwrap(), FIXTURE);
    assert_eq!(fs::metadata(&target_path).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o7777, 0o600);
    assert!(result.file_result.file_synced && result.file_result.renamed && result.file_result.directory_synced);
    assert_eq!(gates.renames, 0, "create does not receive replace rename gate");
    assert!(gates.writes > 1);
    assert_no_temporary_files(&fixture.0);

    let failed = fixture.path("sync-fails.svg");
    let mut gates = Gates { fail_directory_sync: true, ..Gates::default() };
    let result = source_save_noop(FIXTURE, &failed, 128, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Durability);
    assert!(result.file_result.file_synced && result.file_result.renamed);
    assert!(!result.file_result.directory_synced);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(target(&failed)).unwrap(), FIXTURE);
}

/// Validate and tokenize borrowed source before touching the destination, then
/// atomically replace an existing regular file or publish a missing file.
/// `token_capacity` bounds the owned token vector and source/path remain borrowed.
pub fn source_save_noop<'source>(
    source: &'source [u8],
    path: &[u8],
    token_capacity: usize,
    mut hooks: Option<&mut dyn SourceSaveHooks>,
) -> SourceSaveResult<'source> {
    if path.is_empty() {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::Invalid, XmlDiagnostic::default());
    }
    if path.len() > MAX_ATOMIC_FILE_PATH_BYTES {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::PathLimit, XmlDiagnostic::default());
    }
    if source.len() > MAX_INPUT_BYTES {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(
            SourceSaveError::InputLimit,
            XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: MAX_INPUT_BYTES },
        );
    }

    let (tokens, parsed) = tokenize_with_capacity(source, XmlLimits::default(), token_capacity);
    if parsed.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        return SourceSaveResult::error(SourceSaveError::Tokenizer, parsed.diagnostic);
    }

    let replaced = match hooks.as_deref_mut() {
        Some(hook) => atomic_file_replace(path, source, Some(&mut ReplaceAdapter(hook))),
        None => atomic_file_replace(path, source, None),
    };
    let file_result = if replaced.error == AtomicFileReplaceError::NotFound {
        let created = match hooks.as_deref_mut() {
            Some(hook) => atomic_file_create_new(path, source, Some(&mut CreateAdapter(hook))),
            None => atomic_file_create_new(path, source, None),
        };
        map_create_result(created)
    } else {
        replaced
    };
    let error = match file_result.error {
        AtomicFileReplaceError::Ok => SourceSaveError::Ok,
        AtomicFileReplaceError::Durability => SourceSaveError::Durability,
        _ => SourceSaveError::Destination,
    };
    SourceSaveResult {
        error,
        parse_diagnostic: parsed.diagnostic,
        tokens,
        file_result,
        _source: PhantomData,
    }
}

fn map_create_result(created: AtomicFileCreateNewResult) -> AtomicFileReplaceResult {
    AtomicFileReplaceResult {
        error: match created.error {
            AtomicFileCreateNewError::Ok => AtomicFileReplaceError::Ok,
            AtomicFileCreateNewError::Durability => AtomicFileReplaceError::Durability,
            _ => AtomicFileReplaceError::Io,
        },
        file_synced: created.file_synced,
        renamed: created.published,
        directory_synced: created.directory_synced,
    }
}

#[test]
fn validation_precedence_and_tokenizer_diagnostics_prevent_destination_calls() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let valid = b"<svg/>";
    let empty_path: &[u8] = b"";
    let mut gates = Gates::default();
    let result = source_save_noop(valid, empty_path, 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Invalid);
    assert_eq!(source_save_error_name(result.error), "invalid");
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let long_path = vec![b'x'; MAX_ATOMIC_FILE_PATH_BYTES + 1];
    let oversized = vec![b'x'; MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1];
    let result = source_save_noop(&oversized, &long_path, 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::PathLimit, "path limit precedes source limit");
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);
    let result = source_save_noop(&oversized, b"target", 4, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, MAX_INPUT_BYTES);
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let malformed = b"<svg><broken></svg>";
    let missing = fixture.path("must-not-exist.svg");
    let result = source_save_noop(malformed, &missing, 128, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Tokenizer);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::MismatchedTag);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, 13);
    assert!(result.tokens.is_empty());
    assert!(!target(&missing).exists());
    assert_eq!(gates.writes, 0);

    let result = source_save_noop(valid, &missing, 0, Some(&mut gates));
    assert_eq!(result.error, SourceSaveError::Tokenizer);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    assert_eq!(result.parse_diagnostic.offset, 0);
    assert!(!target(&missing).exists());
}
